description: For a person who was turned down by a computer (credit, a job, insurance, an account, benefits, housing). Writes their legal request under UK GDPR Articles 22A-22D and 15 or EU GDPR Articles 22 and 15 (and AI Act Article 86 where it applies), seals it with a timestamp so the one-month deadline is provable, and returns the letter, where to send it, a private tracking link and a reply link the organisation answers through. Give the person the letter and the tracking link, and tell them to keep the tracking link private. Use only the person's real details; ask for what you don't know. Personal details are not stored: only the letter's fingerprint.
name: sebbi_ask_why
title: Challenge an automated decision (Ask Why)
